title: Transport coefficient normalization squares from pro-etale slices
statement: Let X, q:R→S, A,D in D(X_et,R), A′,D′ in D(X_et,S), and dA:A→Res_q A′, dD:D→Res_q D′ be specified. For any U in X_proet, let e and e′ be isomorphisms between their respective comparison images restricted to the slice over U [def-weil-pbc-source-derived-isomorphism-evaluation]. If e.hom followed by the slice comparison normalization arrow of dD equals that of dA followed by Res_q(e′.hom) [def-weil-pbc-slice-comparison-normalization-arrow], then conjugating e and e′ by the canonical slice-to-source localization isomorphisms gives the same square on U.left with localProEtaleNormalization. No weak contractibility, finiteness, or sheaf section is assumed.

proof.text: Transpose the coefficient mate under the pro-etale pullback adjunction. Compatibility of the localization unit identifies this mate with the coefficient map of localization restriction. Lift the pasted identity of exact sheaf functors to derived categories.
Apply naturality of the slice-to-source comparison to dA and dD. The pasted coefficient identity identifies each local normalization arrow with the conjugated slice arrow.
Apply the faithful transport functors to the assumed square; use naturality of their coefficient comparison and cancel the four endpoint isomorphisms. This yields the displayed source-site square.

lean.statement:
theorem sourceSliceNormalization_transport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (A' D' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S)))
    (dA : A ⟶ (normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj A')
    (dD : D ⟶ (normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj D') (U : X.ProEt)
    (e : (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) R U).obj
        ((derivedComparison X R).obj A) ≅
      (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) R U).obj ((derivedComparison X R).obj D))
    (e' : (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) S U).obj
        ((derivedComparison X S).obj A') ≅
      (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) S U).obj ((derivedComparison X S).obj D'))
    (h : e.hom ≫ sliceComparisonNormalizationArrow X R S q dD U =
      sliceComparisonNormalizationArrow X R S q dA U ≫
        (normalizationRestrict ((ProEt.topology X).over U) q).map e'.hom) :
    (((proetDerivedSliceRestrictionIso X R U).app ((derivedComparison X R).obj A)).symm ≪≫
      (proetSliceEquivalence X R U).functor.mapDerivedCategory.mapIso e ≪≫
      (proetDerivedSliceRestrictionIso X R U).app ((derivedComparison X R).obj D)).hom ≫
        localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dD =
      localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dA ≫
        (normalizationRestrict (ProEt.topology U.left) q).map
          (((proetDerivedSliceRestrictionIso X S U).app
              ((derivedComparison X S).obj A')).symm ≪≫
            (proetSliceEquivalence X S U).functor.mapDerivedCategory.mapIso e' ≪≫
            (proetDerivedSliceRestrictionIso X S U).app ((derivedComparison X S).obj D')).hom
